description: Every retained database backup is encrypted with a customer key that is enabled, so it can still be restored

matrix_rows.gap: Database backups only, judged per backup. Object stores are judged by their bucket's default encryption (svc-sin-cfg-aws-stores-use-declared-keys), not object by object.
Retained backups are checked restorable under a live key; their timestamps are not compared with a declared recovery point.
